messages:
nina: CI shard 17 is red on nightly integ against hosted API — seeing intermittent 429s during streaming + tool calls. Anyone available to triage? cc @oncall

sam: saw something similar on shard 21 earlier. Logs flip between 'JWT verification failed: kid not found' and gateway 429s. Could be key rotation + rate-limit.

dylan: can you paste the failing request headers and a short excerpt of the auth logs?

nina: here's the request we captured from the smoke runner:
```
POST /v1/stream?model=redwood-1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Client-KID: kid_abc123
User-Agent: redwood-ci/runner
```
and the proxy line: `auth_proxy: upstream returned 429 when fetching jwks`

lee: quick question — is this only hitting hosted env? dev/staging green?

sam: staging is green. nightly runs hit high parallelism though, so we might be triggering JWKS fetch throttling on the hosted jwks endpoint.

maya: I can rerun shard 17 with reduced concurrency (SHARD_CONCURRENCY=2) to see if it reproduces. Want me to kick that now?

nina: yes please rerun and capture /debug/jwks fetch logs + response headers. also tag the run id.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: shard 17 -> run id ci-3351119-r1 (queued)

dylan: if this is jwks rate-limiting, short-term mitigations: cache jwks for 10m on auth proxy and add jitter on refresh. Long-term: reduce refresh frequency or request quota bump from hosted jwks service.

lee: for triage we should bisect recent auth-proxy releases — suspect change between 2.14.x and 2.15.x that made refreshes more aggressive.

maya: I'm on it — bisecting builds from 2.14.5 -> 2.15.3, will post which commit correlates. kicking rerun now with lower concurrency.

sam: small code-level fallback idea: if kid lookup fails, try verifying against all cached keys before raising hard failure; that should reduce transient failures while cache is warm.

nina: nice. :thumbsup: rerun started, i'll watch logs and attach link when done. also creating an alert for jwks-fetch spikes.

maya: update — rerun completed, shard 17 passed on retry with lower concurrency. uploaded logs: s3://redwood-ci/ci-3351119-r1/logs.txt (includes jwks fetch headers and error counts).

dylan: perfect. action items: maya -> finish bisect, infra -> short-lived jwks cache + telemetry, eng-runtime -> revert aggressive refresh in 2.15 branch if bisect points there. i'll open the three PRs and tag owners.

oncall: thanks folks — if this reappears after the changes we'll promote a temporary rollout freeze while we stabilize jwks handling.
